items.title: Local quasi-finiteness of a locally finite type morphism of algebraic spaces is relative dimension zero everywhere

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a locally of finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is locally quasi-finite if and only if it has relative dimension 0 at every x in |X| (source lines 7076-7083). The proof chooses a presentation diagram with U, V schemes and surjective etale vertical arrows, and uses the definitions to see that h : U -> V is locally quasi-finite exactly when f is and that h has relative dimension 0 at all points of U exactly when f does at all points of |X|; the claim then follows from the corresponding scheme statement.
